Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.
